Name: Desert Garden Pots
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
This mod currently includes 15 designs based on the Free Cactus pot designs already available in game. They are available in two opening styles, "Wide" and "Narrow" and both styles are available via Content Patcher and Alternative Textures.
The Content Patcher component also adds a Desert Garden Catalogue with 6 decorative desert vases and the garden pot (requires 1 clay each). 

[b][size=3]✧ Using This Mod ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod is available as a Content Patcher & Alternative Textures mod. If you wish to use only one, you can pick from the optional files![/*]
[*]Content Patcher will replace the base Garden Pot design with any one style. There is a reference for the 15 styles in the images for this mod page and in the Extras folder included in the CP mod folder.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher configuration can easily be adjusted while playing by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Recommended![/*]
[*]Pot size can be set as wide or narrow. Narrow is closer to the original design while Wide may support more plant sizes.[/*]
[*]Alternative Textures's Paint Bucket can be used to mix-and-match your garden pot designs![/*]
[/list][b][size=3]✧ Compatibility & Known Issues ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]The Content Patcher portion of this mod will conflict with any other mod that modifies the appearance of Garden Pots using Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Narrow pots will fit most fully grown plants, however the mouth of the pot is smaller than standard size. This means fertilizer, many seeds, and even some plants, will not fit well. [/*]
[*]This mod was tested with seeds from a variety of expansions! Crops from Ridgeside Village, Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley, as well as many double-pole trellis plants from a variety of mods do not always fit well in narrow version of pots.[/*]
[*]Alternative Textures currently displays a fertilizer texture on pots when they are empty. [/*]
[*]Desert Garden Catalogue's Garden Pot entry will not be visible in the catalogue if Happy Home Designer is active.[/*]
[/list]
